messages:
alex: planning to flip `feature.safe-mode` to `on` for the evening rollout at 22:00 UTC. who can own the actual toggle and smoke checks?
priya: i can push the toggle at 22:00 if dan or emily can run the smoke checklist. leaving a heads-up for oncall.
dan: i can run the smoke checks 22:05-22:10. what % are we starting canary at?
alex: start at 5% canary for 15m, then 25% for 20m if no regressions, then 100% at 60m. rollback if error rate > 1.5% or latency p50 regresses 2x.
emily: noted. smoke checklist: 1) sanity queries + embeddings on representative tenant, 2) run `curl` across EU/US regions, 3) check prefix-cache hit rate, 4) confirm no auth regressions.
priya: adding safe-defaults: `feature.safe-defaults=true` so if toggle fails we'll fall back to existing path. i.e. config will be `safe-mode:on, safe-defaults:on`.
sasha: quick Q — do we need a schema bump for the flags API? i think no, we only flip an existing boolean.
dan: confirmed no schema bump. also i'll capture a few logs with `rg` and upload to the rollout thread.
deploy-bot: scheduled flag flip job created: job_id=job_1748054321_01, window=22:00-23:30 UTC, executor=priya, notify=#eng-platform.
emily: preflight checklist before 21:45: 1) confirm canary tenant list, 2) verify rollback playbook link, 3) ensure oncall is pinged.
alex: canary tenant list is in the rollout doc: https://redwood.internal/rollouts/1748. priya, please run `./scripts/lock-traffic.sh canary` 5m before flip.
priya: will do. also leaving this note: if we see degradation, do immediate `feature.safe-mode=false` -> then `feature.safe-defaults=true` and trigger rollback runbook.
dan: shorthand commands i will run for smoke: ```bash
# quick health
curl -sS https://api.redwood.prod/health | jq .status
# sample gen
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}' | head -n 5
```
emily: I'll monitor dashboards and alerting. set a 30m post-100% check to validate downstream metrics.
sasha: tagging @oncall in case they need to step in.
alex: ok locked. final go? :thumbsup:
priya: :thumbsup: go for 22:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: job job_1748054321_01 set to execute. notifications will be posted to this thread once started and completed.
priya: posting post-flip checklist here when done so it's easy to find for audit.
dan: i'll attach smoke logs and latency snapshots within 10m after canary.
emily: i'll post dashboard links and any anomalies.
alex: thanks team — i'll be available for rollback if needed
